## Problem and purpose

Explain the concrete need and link the relevant requirement, ADR or milestone.

## Resulting behavior

Describe what the change enables and any material limitations.

## Validation

List commands and actual outcomes. Identify device/build/profile details for runtime claims. State relevant checks not run and why. Link benchmark evidence when making performance claims.

## Decisions and handoff

Note ADR/status/development-guide updates and the next action, if any.
